description: The Aviation Intelligence Portal of EUROCONTROL publishes performance data on European air navigation services, developed by the Aviation Intelligence Unit with the Performance Review Commission and Unit. Its data page offers series on traffic (daily traffic, service units and traffic forecasts), connectivity, punctuality, en-route and airport air traffic flow management delays by entity and cause (daily from 2011 or 2013 and monthly), horizontal and vertical flight efficiency, taxi times and terminal holdings, gate-to-gate CO2, NOx and SOx emissions by state (2019 to 2024) and CO2 by departing state from 2010, and economic data such as ATM cost-effectiveness, unit rates and standard inputs for economic analyses, together with dashboards by airport, air navigation service provider and state. Coverage is continental (the EUROCONTROL area). The data are free to view and download as CSV and Excel files with metadata and definitions, methodology and release notes. Caveats: the indicators follow the Single European Sky performance scheme definitions, some series are revised after operations, and the licence terms are given in the portal disclaimer. The delay, traffic and punctuality series support capacity planning, delay propagation and disruption analysis of the European air network. They complement the EUROCONTROL research data repository and are related to the DGAC air traffic series for France.
